name: Asao Noriharu
source:
The protagonist's father and an ordinary salaryman.

He has a mild-mannered personality, and his son can barely remember ever seeing him get angry, even when they were children.

When it comes to arguments between his parents, his memories are mostly of his mother, Masami, angrily scolding his father, with Noriharu seemingly taking it all without complaint.

He is genuinely happy about and supportive of the protagonist and Sayaka's engagement.

However, given his wife's personality, he tries not to interfere too much or offer unnecessary opinions.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
